props.title: payments-api elevated 5xx errors
props.short_description: payments-api 5xx spiked to 40% ~13m after the v4.12.0 deploy
props.description: PagerDuty routed High5xxRate to SRE at 14:00 UTC. payments-api (prod, tier-1) is returning HTTP 5xx on ~40% of requests; throughput is holding but the error tail is dragging p99 to 4.2s while p50 stays flat. Onset is 13 minutes after release v4.12.0 rolled out at 13:47. Card auth + checkout capture are impacted; revenue-affecting. Investigating the deploy as the prime suspect.
props.work_notes:
[14:02] sre-oncall: High5xxRate paged; errors at 40% on payments-api. v4.12.0 shipped 13:47, ~13m before onset — change-first prime suspect.
[14:26] sre-oncall: Splunk shows a NullPointerException in TaxCalculator, first seen at onset; payments-ora pool healthy (28%). Staging rollback to v4.11.3.

props.short_description: Deploy payments-api v4.12.0 to prod (intl tax-calc)
props.description: Standard release of payments-api v4.12.0 via Argo Rollouts. Bumps the shared taxcalc library to add intl VAT regions. Blue/green with a 10% canary, auto-promoted after the 5-minute analysis gate passed.

props.author: dev-kco
props.message:
feat(tax): add intl VAT regions via shared taxcalc v4.12.0

Route international orders through Region-aware rate lookup. PR #1487, reviewed by dev-lho.

props.statement: NullPointerException in TaxCalculator introduced by commit abc123 (taxcalc intl VAT) shipped in CHG-1/v4.12.0 causes payments-api 5xx spike
payments-ora connection pool saturation or DB fault causes payments-api 5xx

evidence.label: return calc.rate(order.getRegion().getCode());  // v4.12.0: getRegion() is null for intl orders -> NPE
